title: Local-first ship-gate workflow
summary: Agent shipping workflow now verifies changes on local dev before a PR and treats Cloudron deploy as the last post-merge step.
changes: Add a pre-merge local dev verify gate to ship-gate rules and skills.
Reorder post-merge gates to changelog metadata, Cloudron deploy last, then live hub and GitHub Release verification.
Add composer pre-pr-verify to wrap pre-merge checks and a non-destructive local bootstrap.
version_rationale: Patch release: agent shipping workflow and local verify script only; no production application behaviour change.
validation: Ship-gate and release-metadata docs updated consistently across AGENTS.md, README.md, and .cursor rules.
composer pre-pr-verify script added with pre-merge and bootstrap seed steps.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version. To revert this workflow change, restore the prior ship-gate docs and remove the pre-pr-verify script from this release.
provenance: Local-first ship-gate workflow for issue #189, pull request #191.
